filesystemContract.leaseVerification: Actual same exclusive handle; no second metadata open.
filesystemContract.unknownOutcome: Persistent guard/orphan/unknown HOLD; no automatic clearing, retry, lease steal or pruning.

filesystemContract.guardFinalization: Retain CREATE_NEW exclusive guard handle with DELETE access but without creation-time delete-on-close. Same-handle FileDispositionInfo with one-byte BOOLEAN; single close attempt, no path deletion or raw-close retry.
filesystemContract.terminalOrdering: Immutable OUTCOME, then durable FINALIZING pointer, exact-owned guard finalization, then terminal pointer. Finalization/final-pointer uncertainty remains HOLD even if the guard leaf is absent.
filesystemContract.controlFileLinks: Same-held-handle FILE_STANDARD_INFO must report one link, not delete-pending and not directory before control-record JSON reads/writes. Not applied to toolchain files or Cargo outputs.
